# Yaran Linux GRUB 2 theme
#
# Used by the INSTALLED system: hooks/desktop/grub-theme.sh installs this
# directory to /usr/share/grub/themes/yaran and points GRUB_THEME at it, so
# `update-grub` (run by Calamares on the target) generates a branded menu.
# The live ISO keeps its own separate menu generated by build.py.
#
# Fonts: generated at install time into fonts/ by the hook (DejaVu Sans from
# fonts-dejavu-core; falls back to Unifont if DejaVu is unavailable).

title-text: "Yaran Linux"
desktop-image: "background.png"
title-color: "#E7F5EC"
title-font: "DejaVu Sans Regular 20"
message-color: "#C9E7D6"
message-font: "DejaVu Sans Regular 14"
terminal-color: "#E7F5EC"
terminal-font: "DejaVu Sans Mono Regular 14"
terminal-left: "0"
terminal-top: "25%"
terminal-width: "100%"
terminal-height: "50%"
terminal-border: "0"

+ boot_menu {
  left = 19%
  top = 34%
  width = 62%
  height = 34%

  item_font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 16"
  item_color = "#C9E7D6"
  item_spacing = 8
  item_height = 30
  item_padding = 5
  item_icon_space = 8

  selected_item_font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 16"
  selected_item_color = "#FFFFFF"

  icon_width = 32
  icon_height = 32
}

+ label {
  left = 0
  top = 91%
  width = 100%
  height = 30
  align = "center"
  text = "Enter: boot    e: edit options    c: command line    esc: menu"
  color = "#9DBFAC"
  font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 12"
}

+ label {
  left = 0
  top = 4%
  width = 100%
  height = 34
  align = "center"
  text = "Yaran Linux"
  color = "#E7F5EC"
  font = "DejaVu Sans Regular 20"
}
